visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera frames a medical setting. A male medical professional wearing green scrubs with a 'JUST MAKE' logo, glasses, and a surgical mask stands over a female patient lying in a bed. The patient wears a pink surgical cap and is covered by a grey quilted blanket. Background shows medical equipment like intravenous pumps and a monitor displaying data. (2) The medical professional holds a transparent plastic anesthesia mask near the patient's face while looking at her attentively. The patient looks upwards, her mouth moving as she speaks. A large microphone with a thick fuzzy windscreen is visible in the upper right corner, held by an off-screen person. The lighting is bright and even. (3) The professional places the anesthesia mask firmly over the patient's nose and mouth. The patient's eyelids gradually droop and eventually close completely as she enters a state of unconsciousness. The medical professional continues to monitor her state while adjusting the equipment. The scene remains stable until the video ends.

The background is absent of music, featuring only a very low-level indoor ambient hum. (2) A female voice responds to the questions. Her tone starts energetic and clear, but her speech rate gradually slows down, and her articulation becomes slightly slurred and dreamy as the clip progresses. (3) Rhythmic, high-pitched electronic beeps from a medical monitor occur consistently in the background. The sound of gas or air movement from anesthesia equipment is audible as the mask is applied. (4) The male voice provides a final, comforting confirmation that the procedure is beginning. The rhythmic monitor beeps remain the most prominent acoustic feature as the clip concludes.
